info.description: The Business Portfolio Analysis API enables users to access detailed insights into business analysis based on specific parameters. This endpoint allows consumers to retrieve data related to product portfolio performance, empowering stakeholders to make informed business decisions. Typical users include financial analysts, product managers, and market researchers seeking to evaluate the success of various products. By leveraging this API, organizations can enhance their strategic planning and resource allocation based on analyzed trends and metrics.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the details of a specific product portfolio by its unique identifier. It provides comprehensive information relevant to the specified portfolio, facilitating business analysis.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the product portfolio details for the specified product ID. It should include all necessary parameters required for fetching the relevant data related to the product outlined in the endpoint.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the product portfolio data.
